top_signals.title: Botswana Utility to Tap Fiber, Wheeling to Almost Triple Revenue
top_signals.summary: Botswana’s loss-making power utility plans to charge independent producers to wheel electricity to clients using its grid and commercialize 850 kilometers (528 miles) of unused fiber to boost revenue almost threefold by 2031.

top_signals.title: Lead Senate Republican Lummis rejects Democratic counteroffer as Clarity Act vote nears
top_signals.summary: Hours ahead of an initial vote on the Clarity Act, Senate Republicans are pushing back against a counterproposal from fellow Democrats.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
